eyebrow.zh: 开源 · MIT · 严格只读 · 全离线
eyebrow.en: Open source · MIT · Read-only · Fully offline

headline.zh:
把编码 Agent 的最新结论
钉在终端顶部
headline.en:
Pin your coding agent's live
conclusion to the top

sub.zh: 上万行的长会话里，Agent 的最新结论永远埋在 transcript 尾部。tailpin 把它变成一块实时刷新的置顶答案面板：结论逐条拆分、一键跳回原始记录、跨会话 diff——严格只读，全离线，无 API key。
sub.en: In a session that runs to ten thousand lines, the agent's latest conclusion lives only at the transcript's tail. tailpin turns it into a live pinned answer panel: claims split one by one, each jumping back to its raw record, plus a cross-run diff — strictly read-only, fully offline, no API key.

caption.en: The session grows; the conclusion stays pinned

body.zh: 结论按 claim 拆分，逐条标注 finding / plan / fix / caveat。会话文件一有追加，面板约 1 秒内重绘（250ms 追加轮询），答案变化时 revision 递增，重启后从磁盘继续累计。
body.en: The conclusion is split into claims, each tagged finding / plan / fix / caveat. Every append redraws the panel within about a second (250ms append-only polling); the revision bumps as the answer changes and continues from disk across restarts.

body.zh: j/k 在结论间移动，Enter 跳到产生这条结论的原始 transcript 记录——行号、消息 uuid、ISO 8601 时间戳齐全。启发式看走眼时一眼就能看出来，transcript 始终是 ground truth。
body.en: j/k move between claims; Enter jumps to the exact raw transcript record behind one — line, message uuid, ISO 8601 timestamp. A misread heuristic is visible at a glance, and the transcript stays ground truth.

title.zh: 严格只读，全离线确定性

body.zh: 抽结论靠启发式打分而不是 LLM：无 API key、无网络请求。tailpin 永远不写 harness 的 transcript，自己写的只有 pin 工件，临时文件 + rename 原子落盘，中途被杀也不会留下半个 JSON。
body.en: Extraction is heuristic scoring, not an LLM: no API key, no network requests. tailpin never writes the harness transcript; the only files it writes are its own pin artifacts, saved atomically via temp file + rename, so a kill mid-write can never leave half a JSON behind.

title.en: After a rerun, a claim-level diff

body.zh: 同一任务跑两遍，tailpin diff 逐条对比两次运行的结论：哪些新提出、哪些被推翻、哪些改了措辞。没有 watch 过的历史会话也可以直接 diff（现场抽取）。
body.en: Run the same task twice and tailpin diff compares the two runs claim by claim: newly claimed, dropped, reworded. Past sessions you never watched can still be diffed, extracted on the spot.

title.zh: 上万行会话，你只想读最后十行
title.en: Ten thousand lines in, you only want the last ten

body.zh: Claude Code 的长会话动辄上万行，Agent 的最新结论永远埋在 transcript 尾部；本地长思考模型上的 Opencode 会话，还把结论埋进长长的思考流里。跑一次四十分钟的任务，你真正想读的可能只有最后十行。tailpin 把这十行变成一块实时更新的置顶答案面板。它和 prompt skill 是互补而不是竞争：caveman、i-have-adhd 这类 skill 改变 Agent 怎么说，tailpin 改变你看哪里。
body.en: A Claude Code session runs to ten thousand lines and its latest conclusion lives only at the transcript's tail; on local long-reasoning models the conclusion sits inside a long thinking stream on top of that. A forty-minute task may have ten lines you actually want to read. tailpin turns those ten lines into a live pinned answer panel. It composes with prompt skills rather than competing: caveman-style skills change how the agent talks; tailpin changes where you look.

title.zh: 从追加到置顶：一秒内的更新链路
title.en: From append to pin: the one-second loop

body.zh: tailpin 以 250ms 追加轮询只读跟踪会话文件：新记录一到，adapter 按类型过滤出 assistant 文本块（mode、queue-operation、file-history-snapshot 等记录直接跳过），extractor 用时近性、中英文结论标记、代码块和路径做确定性打分选出当前答案并拆成 claim，store 把带版本的 pin 工件原子落盘到 ~/.tailpin/sessions/<session_id>.pin.json，TUI 与 --plain 面板随之重绘。
body.en: tailpin follows the session file read-only with 250ms append-only polling: as records arrive, the adapter lifts assistant text spans by type (mode, queue-operation, file-history-snapshot records are skipped), the extractor deterministically ranks spans by recency, EN/ZH conclusion markers, code blocks and file paths, splits the answer into claims, the store atomically writes the revisioned pin artifact to ~/.tailpin/sessions/<session_id>.pin.json, and the TUI and --plain panel redraw.

alt.zh: 更新链路：追加轮询、按类型过滤、确定性打分、原子落盘、面板重绘
alt.en: The update loop: append polling, type filtering, deterministic ranking, atomic store, panel redraw

title.zh: 一个 Go 二进制，四个内部包，零模型调用
title.en: One Go binary, four internal packages, zero model calls

body.zh: transcript adapter 只认识 Claude-Code 风格 JSONL 这一种方言（消息记录、uuid、ISO 8601 时间戳）；pin extractor 负责确定性打分，把答案拆成带 span 溯源的 claim；pin store 原子保存 PinnedAnswer { session_id, revision, updated_at, confidence, claims[] }，每个 Claim 带 finding / plan / fix / caveat 类型与行号、字节区间、消息 uuid、时间戳；bubbletea TUI 呈现答案面板与溯源视图，diff 走 CLI 输出。支持别的 transcript 格式意味着写一个新 adapter，而不是到处改代码。
body.en: The transcript adapter knows exactly one dialect, Claude-Code-style JSONL (message records, uuids, ISO 8601 timestamps); the pin extractor does the deterministic ranking and splits the answer into claims with span provenance; the pin store atomically saves PinnedAnswer { session_id, revision, updated_at, confidence, claims[] }, each Claim carrying a finding / plan / fix / caveat kind plus line range, byte range, message uuid and timestamp; the bubbletea TUI renders the answer pane and span viewer, and diff is plain CLI output. Supporting another transcript format means writing a new adapter, not touching the rest of the code.

alt.zh: 架构：adapter、extractor、store、TUI 四层，结论工件单独落盘
alt.en: Architecture: adapter, extractor, store and TUI layers, with the pinned answer as its own artifact

body.zh: 裸 tailpin 自动选中 ~/.claude/projects 下最新活跃的会话（嵌套的 subagent / journal 文件不参与发现）；tailpin watch 接任何 Claude-Code 风格 JSONL 文件——Opencode 等写出同方言的会话同样适用。CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR 环境变量覆盖 harness 配置目录。安装走 go install（Go 1.24+），或从 Releases 下载 macOS / Linux / Windows 二进制（每个版本附带 sha256 校验和）。
body.en: Bare tailpin auto-picks the most recently active session under ~/.claude/projects (nested subagent / journal files never surface); tailpin watch accepts any Claude-Code-style JSONL file — sessions written by Opencode and other harnesses speaking the same dialect work the same way. The CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable overrides the harness config directory. Install via go install (Go 1.24+) or grab macOS / Linux / Windows binaries from Releases, each version shipping sha256 checksums.

alt.zh: 当前接入：Claude Code 会话目录、任意同方言 JSONL、CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR 覆盖、 Releases 二进制
alt.en: What plugs in today: the Claude Code projects root, any same-dialect JSONL file, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR override, Release binaries

body.zh: tailpin 自动发现最新活跃会话并进入 TUI；watch 盯指定文件，--plain 输出无 TUI 的纯文本实时面板（适合管道与无交互终端）；diff 无参数时对比同项目最新两个会话，diff <idA> <idB> 显式指定。j/k 在结论间移动（溯源视图打开时滚动视图），Enter 打开当前结论的原始记录，esc 返回，q 退出；tailpin help / tailpin version 查看帮助与版本。
body.en: tailpin auto-discovers the latest active session and opens the TUI; watch follows a specific file, with --plain streaming the live panel without the TUI (pipes and non-interactive terminals); diff with no arguments compares the newest session against the previous one in the same project, and diff <idA> <idB> picks both explicitly. j/k move between claims (scrolling the span viewer once open), Enter opens the raw record behind the selected claim, esc goes back, q quits; tailpin help / tailpin version print help and version.

details.code:
tailpin
tailpin watch path/to/session.jsonl
tailpin watch path/to/session.jsonl --plain
tailpin diff
tailpin diff run-a run-b
tailpin help

body.zh: 唯一的配置是环境变量 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR（默认 ~/.claude，projects 根目录随之变为 <dir>/projects）。pin 工件落在 ~/.tailpin/sessions/<session_id>.pin.json；diff 优先读已存工件，没有 watch 过的历史会话现场抽取。v0.1 刻意收窄的边界见下方「接入前需要知道」。
body.en: The only configuration is the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable (default ~/.claude; the projects root becomes <dir>/projects). Pin artifacts land in ~/.tailpin/sessions/<session_id>.pin.json; diff prefers stored artifacts and extracts on the spot for sessions you never watched. The deliberately narrow v0.1 boundaries are listed below under Before you integrate.

note.zh: 以下命令与输出逐字复制自仓库自带示例会话（examples/projects/-Users-dev-work-api-server/）上的真实运行；仓库内还有一段 26 秒的 asciinema v2 实况录制，覆盖同样的三个动作。
note.en: Commands and outputs below are copied verbatim from real runs over the example sessions bundled in the repo (examples/projects/-Users-dev-work-api-server/); the repo also ships a real 26-second asciinema v2 recording covering the same three moves.

body.zh: 无 TUI 的纯文本面板：答案立即置顶，每条结论带 L20 行号溯源，会话追加后约 1 秒内刷新。
body.en: The plain-text panel without the TUI: the answer pins immediately, each claim tagged with its L20 provenance, refreshing within about a second of each append.

title.en: From install to a pinned panel

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+，或从 Releases 下载 macOS / Linux / Windows 二进制（每个版本附带 sha256 校验和）。仓库自带两条示例会话，不需要装 Claude Code 就能跑通全流程。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+, or grab a macOS / Linux / Windows binary from Releases (every version ships with sha256 checksums). The two example sessions bundled in the repo walk the whole flow without Claude Code installed.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/tailpin.git
cd tailpin/examples

# plain panel: the answer pins immediately, each claim with L20 provenance
tailpin watch projects/-Users-dev-work-api-server/run-b.jsonl --plain

# TUI: j/k between claims · enter jumps to the raw record · esc back · q quit
tailpin watch projects/-Users-dev-work-api-server/run-b.jsonl

# cross-run diff: same task run twice, claims compared one by one
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=. tailpin diff run-a run-b

tailpin                              # auto-discover the latest session (TUI)
tailpin watch path/to/session.jsonl  # any Claude-Code-style JSONL file

limitations.zh: 只读观察：mid-run 的 accept / annotate 是 v0.2 候选，前提是先验证真的有人把 tailpin 挂在长会话旁边用。
limitations.en: Read-only observability: mid-run accept / annotate is a v0.2 candidate, gated on evidence that people actually keep tailpin open beside long runs.

limitations.zh: 只支持 Claude-Code 风格 JSONL 一种 transcript 方言；支持别的格式意味着写一个新 adapter，而不是到处改代码。
limitations.en: One transcript dialect only, Claude-Code-style JSONL; supporting another format means writing a new adapter, not touching the rest of the code.

limitations.zh: 一个 tailpin 进程看一个会话；没有 Web UI、没有推送通知、不做记忆回注。
limitations.en: One session per tailpin process; no web UI, no push notifications, no memory reinjection.

limitations.zh: 启发式打分会看走眼：每条结论都带溯源，选错了一眼就能看出来，transcript 始终是 ground truth。
limitations.en: Heuristic scoring can misread: every claim carries provenance, a wrong pick is visible at a glance, and the transcript stays ground truth.

limitations.zh: Windows 二进制随 release 一起构建，但在 Windows 上未经测试。
limitations.en: Windows binaries are built with each release but untested on Windows.

headline.en: Let the agent run; the conclusion stays in view

sub.en: Free and open source (MIT) · no API key · no config

tag.zh: 只读、离线、确定性——transcript 永远是 ground truth。
tag.en: Read-only, offline, deterministic — the transcript stays ground truth.
